name: aim-workout-journal
description: Workout journal for ChatGPT: log workouts in plain language, correct them, read progress computed from your own sets, and plan from your own training data.

interface.longDescription:
AIm Workout Journal keeps your training log and connects it to ChatGPT. Describe a workout in the chat and ChatGPT saves it. Say a set was wrong and it corrects that set. Ask it to delete a workout logged by mistake and, once you confirm, it is deleted. The numbers you ask about come from your own history.

If you do not have a journal yet, AIm creates one the first time you sign in. The journal opens in the browser on any phone, in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese or Russian.

With a new journal, start by asking ChatGPT: Make me a workout program in AIm for 3 days a week. ChatGPT asks a few questions about your goal, experience, schedule and equipment, plans the program from your answers and saves it to your journal once you approve it. Then log each workout in the chat, or open the day in the app and follow it set by set.

What you can do
- Log a workout in your own words. ChatGPT saves the exercises, sets, reps and weights to your journal, and cardio too.
- Fix a mistake later, such as the weight or reps of one set, or delete a workout logged by accident.
- Ask how you are doing: recent workouts, personal records, estimated one rep max and training volume. AIm computes these figures on its server from your logged sets.
- Plan your next workout or a new program. AIm gives ChatGPT your goal, experience, schedule, equipment and recent working weights, and ChatGPT plans from them. AIm checks every new program before it goes into your journal, and ChatGPT saves it only after you approve it.
- See your program, or a new one before it is saved, as a card in the chat with a picture for every exercise.
- Ask how to do an exercise and get its technique, cues and pictures in the chat.
- Set training goals and review a training week.
- Mark the other activities you do, such as football or yoga, on the days you did them.
- Bring in a program or training history from a file you share in the chat, once you confirm what was read.

The same journal opens as a mobile web app at aim-journal.com with your history, progress charts, an estimated muscle load map, your program, a calendar of workouts and activities, and a workout screen for the gym. A workout you run in the app is available to ChatGPT, and a workout you log in ChatGPT shows up in the app.

Who it is for
People who train at a gym, at home or outdoors and want ChatGPT to remember what they actually did.

Limitations
- AIm is a training log. It does not collect health information and does not assess pain or injuries.
- Estimated one rep max and the muscle load map are estimates calculated from your logged sets.
- You sign in with your email address. There is no password. If your browser does not know your journal yet, AIm sends a six digit code to your email.
- AIm reads and writes only your own journal. It does not connect directly to wearables or other fitness apps. An export file from another app can be imported through the chat.
- You can export all your data from the app as an Excel or JSON file.
capabilities: Program card and exercise technique with pictures
defaultPrompt: Make me a workout program in AIm for 3 days a week
Log today's workout in AIm: bench press 3 sets of 8 at 60 kg, then 3 sets of 10 pull-ups
Show me the technique for a Romanian deadlift from AIm

positive.description: Log a completed workout described in plain language. Creates one session dated today with two exercises and six sets.
positive.prompt: Log today's workout: bench press 3 sets of 8 at 60 kg, then pull-ups 3 sets of 6 with bodyweight.
positive.expected_behavior: One log_session call (ChatGPT may first call search_exercise_pool or list_exercises to match the exercise names). ChatGPT confirms the save in one line. The session appears in the AIm web app history for the test account, dated today, with Barbell Bench Press 3 x 8 at 60 kg and pull-ups 3 x 6 at bodyweight.

positive.description: Read progress for one exercise from the seeded history. Read only.
positive.prompt: How has my bench press progressed over the last two months?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT reads the seeded bench press sessions from AIm, with get_sessions and get_session or with get_stats kind progression, and reports dated top sets that rise from about 62.5 kg to about 72.5 kg over the seeded weeks, with estimated one rep max. Nothing is written. The figures match the Progress screen of the web app.

positive.description: Plan the next workout from the user's own data: completed intake, active Push Pull Legs program and recent weights. Read only.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls get_coaching_context with task next_workout and answers with the next day of the active Push Pull Legs program: each exercise with sets x reps and a weight range based on the recently logged weights. No workout is logged and the program is not changed; the answer ends with short next steps on how to record the workout.

positive.description: Correct one set of a logged workout. Depends on the first positive case having been run.
positive.prompt: Correction: in today's bench press the second set was 62.5 kg, not 60.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds today's session with get_sessions and get_session, then calls update_set on set 2 of the bench press only. It confirms the corrected weight in one line. In the web app the second set shows 62.5 kg and the other sets are unchanged.

positive.description: Show the saved program as a card in the chat. Read only.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls get_program. A card appears under the tool call with the three days of the Push Pull Legs program, each exercise with its sets and reps and a picture. Nothing is written.

negative.description: Request outside the plugin's function. AIm is a training journal and cannot book classes or contact gyms.
negative.prompt: Book me a spin class at my gym for Friday.
negative.expected_behavior: No AIm tool is called. ChatGPT explains that AIm keeps a training log and cannot book classes; nothing is written to the journal.

negative.description: Bulk deletion of all history. AIm has no bulk delete, and deleting a whole training history is irreversible.
negative.expected_behavior: AIm has no bulk delete, so nothing can be removed in one call. delete_session is marked destructive: ChatGPT asks for confirmation before each single deletion. Denying every confirmation, or telling ChatGPT to stop, leaves all workouts in place.

negative.description: Request for another person's data. AIm only reads and writes the journal of the signed-in account; no tool accepts another user or email.
negative.prompt: Show me the workouts of my friend Alex, his email is alex@example.com.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT declines: the connected AIm account can only access its own journal. No tool is called for another account, and no data about anyone else is returned.

review.commerce_description: AIm sells nothing and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: Listing text only: it now starts from an empty journal (ask for a first program), puts correcting and deleting workouts first, and has new conversation starters that work on a new journal. No tool was added.

fr-FR.subtitle: Notez vos séances de sport
fr-FR.description:
AIm Workout Journal tient votre carnet d'entraînement et le relie à ChatGPT : une séance décrite dans la conversation est enregistrée, et les chiffres que vous demandez viennent de votre propre historique.

Si vous n'avez pas encore de carnet, AIm le crée lors de votre première connexion. Le carnet s'ouvre dans le navigateur de n'importe quel téléphone, en français, anglais, espagnol, portugais ou russe. Avec un carnet neuf, commencez par demander un programme : ChatGPT vous pose quelques questions sur votre objectif, votre niveau, votre emploi du temps et votre matériel, prépare le programme et l'enregistre dans votre carnet avec votre accord.

Notez une séance avec vos mots (exercices, séries, répétitions, charges, cardio), corrigez une série ou supprimez une séance. Demandez vos records, votre maximum estimé sur une répétition et votre volume d'entraînement : AIm les calcule sur son serveur à partir de vos séries. Pour planifier une séance ou un programme, AIm transmet à ChatGPT votre objectif, votre niveau, votre emploi du temps, votre matériel et vos charges récentes. AIm vérifie chaque nouveau programme, et ChatGPT ne l'enregistre qu'avec votre accord. Votre programme et la technique de chaque exercice s'affichent dans le chat sous forme de carte avec des images.

Le même carnet s'ouvre dans une application web mobile sur aim-journal.com, avec l'historique, les graphiques de progression, la carte estimée de charge musculaire et un écran de séance pour la salle.

AIm est un carnet d'entraînement. Connexion par adresse e-mail, sans mot de passe. Vos données sont exportables en Excel ou JSON.

pt-BR.subtitle: Registre seus treinos no chat
pt-BR.description:
O AIm Workout Journal guarda o seu diário de treino e o conecta ao ChatGPT: um treino descrito na conversa fica salvo, e os números que você pergunta vêm do seu próprio histórico.

Se você ainda não tem um diário, o AIm cria um no seu primeiro acesso. O diário abre no navegador de qualquer celular, em português, inglês, espanhol, francês ou russo. Com um diário novo, comece pedindo um programa: o ChatGPT faz algumas perguntas sobre o seu objetivo, experiência, agenda e equipamento, prepara o programa e o salva no seu diário depois da sua aprovação.

Registre um treino com as suas palavras (exercícios, séries, repetições, cargas, cardio), corrija uma série ou apague um treino. Pergunte pelos seus recordes, pela carga máxima estimada para uma repetição e pelo volume de treino: o AIm calcula esses números no servidor a partir das suas séries. Para planejar um treino ou um programa, o AIm entrega ao ChatGPT o seu objetivo, experiência, agenda, equipamento e cargas recentes. O AIm confere cada programa novo, e o ChatGPT só o salva depois da sua aprovação. O seu programa e a técnica de cada exercício aparecem no chat como um cartão com imagens.

O mesmo diário abre como aplicativo web no celular em aim-journal.com, com histórico, gráficos de progresso, mapa estimado de carga muscular e uma tela de treino para a academia.

O AIm é um diário de treino. O acesso é pelo e-mail, sem senha. Seus dados podem ser exportados em Excel ou JSON.

es-ES.subtitle: Registre sus entrenamientos
es-ES.description:
AIm Workout Journal guarda su diario de entrenamiento y lo conecta con ChatGPT: un entrenamiento descrito en la conversación queda guardado, y las cifras por las que pregunta salen de su propio historial.

Si aún no tiene un diario, AIm lo crea en su primer acceso. El diario se abre en el navegador de cualquier móvil, en español, inglés, francés, portugués o ruso. Con un diario nuevo, empiece pidiendo un programa: ChatGPT le hace algunas preguntas sobre su objetivo, experiencia, horario y equipamiento, prepara el programa y lo guarda en su diario después de su aprobación.

Registre un entrenamiento con sus palabras (ejercicios, series, repeticiones, pesos, cardio), corrija una serie o borre un entrenamiento. Pregunte por sus récords, su máximo estimado a una repetición y su volumen de entrenamiento: AIm los calcula en su servidor a partir de sus series. Para planificar un entrenamiento o un programa, AIm entrega a ChatGPT su objetivo, experiencia, horario, equipamiento y pesos recientes. AIm revisa cada programa nuevo, y ChatGPT solo lo guarda después de su aprobación. Su programa y la técnica de cada ejercicio se muestran en el chat como una tarjeta con imágenes.

El mismo diario se abre como aplicación web en el móvil en aim-journal.com, con historial, gráficos de progreso, mapa estimado de carga muscular y una pantalla de entrenamiento para el gimnasio.

AIm es un diario de entrenamiento. El acceso es con su correo electrónico, sin contraseña. Sus datos se pueden exportar en Excel o JSON.

ru-RU.subtitle: Дневник тренировок в чате
ru-RU.description:
AIm Workout Journal ведёт твой дневник тренировок и подключает его к ChatGPT: тренировка, о которой ты рассказываешь в чате, сохраняется, а цифры, о которых ты спрашиваешь, берутся из твоей собственной истории.

Если дневника ещё нет, он создастся при первом входе в AIm. Дневник открывается в браузере на любом телефоне, на русском, английском, испанском, французском или португальском. С новым дневником начни с программы: ChatGPT задаст несколько вопросов про цель, опыт, расписание и оборудование, составит программу и сохранит её в дневник после твоего согласия.

Запиши тренировку своими словами (упражнения, подходы, повторения, веса, кардио), исправь подход или удали тренировку. Спроси про рекорды, расчётный максимум на одно повторение и объём тренировок: AIm считает их на своём сервере по твоим подходам. Чтобы спланировать тренировку или программу, AIm передаёт ChatGPT твою цель, опыт, расписание, оборудование и недавние рабочие веса. AIm проверяет каждую новую программу, а ChatGPT сохраняет её только после твоего согласия. Программа и техника каждого упражнения показываются прямо в чате в виде карточек с картинками.

Тот же дневник открывается как мобильное веб-приложение на aim-journal.com: история, графики прогресса, примерная карта нагрузки мышц и экран тренировки для зала.

AIm ведёт дневник тренировок. Вход по почте, без пароля. Данные можно выгрузить в Excel или JSON.
